critical_code_review_comments: Testid naming drift between review-request spec and actual code: review mentioned roi-monthly-hours / roi-annual-hours / roi-saved-annual / roi-days-back / roi-hero-monthly, but code emits roi-monthly-output / roi-annual-output / roi-saved-output / roi-workdays-output (no roi-hero-monthly — hero uses roi-dark-panel + roi-monthly-output). Not a bug — behavior is correct — but keep spec/code in sync to avoid confusion in future tests.

RoiCalculator useTween animates values; raw snapshots within <500ms of input change read mid-tween values (e.g. saved shows 2,877 then settles to 2,880). Not a bug; just ensure any future automated assertions wait ~2s after input.
